cpp_hia_native_build.external_abi: scalar-only C functions; resource and multiple-result functions are internal
runtime_assumptions: Linux LP64 target with 64-bit pointers and size_t
C calloc returns null or an initialized nonaliasing allocation of the requested size
C malloc returns null or a fresh nonaliasing allocation of the requested size; bytes are initialized before read or remain unobserved
C free accepts a live allocation from calloc or malloc, or null
abort terminates execution; no cleanup after traps is promised
native compiler, linker, loader, libc and host hardware are trusted

limitations: Only the complete closed owner and lifecycle protocol is admitted.
Source moved-from inspection, pointer escape, custom allocators and arbitrary cleanup code are rejected.
C++ exceptions become explicit Result errors; C++ class ABI and general source equivalence are not claimed.
Output uses checked Buffer bounds; undefined source out-of-bounds access is outside the domain.
